entries.dialogueText: "The creation of the Regional Senate is progressing steadily, with candidates actively campaigning."

entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, they'd save everyone time by skipping the elections altogether and appointing actors to read from a script."

entries.dialogueText: "At least then they wouldn't have to pretend this is anything more than a farce."

entries.dialogueText: "Until the new legislative building is complete. the Grand Hall of Palas Rezna will serve as their stage."
